meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 DuckDB、Polars 等常驻内核引擎处理 CSV/Parquet/JSON,做分组、连接、聚合、时间序列、清洗和绘图;先探测文件大小和可用内存,再决定就地查询还是载入内存,并报告行数和耗时。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,或做分组、连接、聚合时,它接管数据处理工作。

say.text: 帮我分析 data.csv,按地区分组统计销售额
say.note: 就地跑 DuckDB 查询,并报行数与耗时

say.text: 把这两张表按用户 ID 连接起来,看重叠多少
say.note: 用 DuckDB 做 join,不走 pandas

say.text: 画出这份数据的月度趋势图
say.note: 先读可视化参考,再做图并做视觉检查

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes CSV/Parquet/JSON with resident engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools: group-by, joins, aggregation, time series, cleaning, plotting. It probes file size and RAM first, then queries in place or loads into memory.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze CSV, Parquet or JSON data, or to run group-by, joins or aggregation on a dataset.

say_en.text: Analyze data.csv and group sales by region.
say_en.note: Runs a DuckDB query in place, reports row counts and timing.

say_en.text: Join these two tables on user ID and show the overlap.
say_en.note: Uses a DuckDB join; never pandas.

say_en.text: Plot the monthly trend for this dataset.
say_en.note: Reads the visualization reference, then does a visual check.
